differences.what: massing: a narrow stone town house of three storeys over a raised basement between party walls, its front filled by an oriel over two arches; the draft stood a grey flat-roofed brick box
differences.how: T-2433: K01 frontage on the 1911 sheet's plan (19.5 by 6.2 m), a K02 Lemont limestone front over a rusticated base on K03 brick party walls; through the camera the front's edges land within 5-7 px of the drawing's and the main cornice at 9.75 m within about 3 px

differences.what: storey lines: the principal floor at the stoop's head (about 1.85 m), the second floor at the oriel's sill (about 5.8 m), the main cornice at about 9.7 m
differences.how: T-2433: a 1.85 m principal floor read off the drawing, 3.9 and 4.0 m storeys; the bands fall within about 3-10 px of the drawing's

differences.what: the north arch: a broad round-arched window in the principal storey, its sill at about 2.1 m and its crown at about 4.4 m under a ring of long voussoirs, a basement light under it
differences.how: T-2433: K01's arched principal light on K06's wide fanlight sash, 1.6 m across under a 0.35 m voussoir ring, its sill and crown within about 3 px; K06's round-headed basement light under it. Its lattice transom and the drawing's 1.8 m width are the next two rows

differences.what: the oriel's place and second storey: a canted oriel on corbelling over the arches, its sill at the second floor, four tall transomed lights across its front and one in each cant
differences.how: T-2433: K08's canted corbelled oriel centred on the front from the second floor on four corbel courses, four K06 transomed lights 0.4 m across to its front and one 0.35 m in each cant; its sill within about 10 px

differences.what: the oriel's size: about 4.8 m across at the wall, 3.4 m of front and about 0.9 m out; the build's is 3.38 m, 2.4 m and 0.5 m, so its edges stand 27-40 px inside the drawing's
differences.how: T-2435: K01 lays no opening whose centre falls under an oriel's span (the window and door stand under the drawing's) and four corbel courses carry 0.5 m; docs/RESEARCH/k01-1623-farwell-2433/README.md § What K01 could not do

differences.what: the oriel above its second storey: a carved frieze at about 8.1-9.0 m, an upper stage of five shorter lights to about 10.4 m, and a steep conical slate roof with a finial whose eave stands at about 10.9 m, above the main cornice, and apex at about 13.4 m; the build's oriel stops at 8.55 m under a low copper hood, under a 45-degree hip
differences.how: T-2435: K01 keeps an oriel's top a metre under the main eave

differences.what: the entrance: a deep round arch matching the window's, a glazed door under a carved light within it; the build has K07's flat-headed panelled door

the openings' places: the drawing's window arch is centred about 1.55 m from the north wall and the entrance arch about 4.6 m; the build's stand at 1.45 and 4.85 m, so that the oriel can stand between their centres
the basement light: a broad segmental opening behind an ornamental iron grille, about 1.8 m wide; the build's is a 1.1 m round-headed light without a grille
the stoop: the drawing's climbs straight up from the walk between iron rails and stone newels; the build's is a plain straight stoop with cheeks
the stone: the drawing rusticates the front in big rock-faced blocks from grade to the arches' springing; the build lays two smooth-channelled base courses to 1.0 m and smooth stone above
the roof and stack: the drawing slates a steep roof behind the cone and stands a tall stack, stepped, on the north wall near the front
differences.how: T-2433: a 45-degree slate hip whose ridge (12.85 m) stands where the drawing's slope tops out (about 12.7 m), and a K15 stack on the north party wall 2.9 m behind the front; its steps are not built

differences.what: the front's width: the drawing's front is about 6.5 m, the 1911 sheet's 6.2 m
differences.how: the sheet controls the plan, as at 1619 (T-2420)

differences.what: colour and tone: the drawing is a monochrome pen plate
differences.how: the stone (Lemont limestone), brick and paint are reconstructed, L-k01-1623-farwell-oriel-front-2433
